reflection: Look at the items marked E. What have you been trying to guarantee? Where did the sense that it was yours to guarantee come from?
Look at the items marked S. For each, name the kind of help it needs: a friend, a spouse, a pastor, a doctor, a counsellor, a colleague, a professional service.

Look at the items marked?. For each, name the right kind of guidance. A pastor or counsellor is not the correct authority for every burden; some need a doctor or mental-health professional, a domestic-abuse specialist, a safeguarding leader, a lawyer or financial adviser, an employer or HR representative, or a trusted family member.
Was anything on the list laid on you in God's name that Jesus might describe as a heavy burden, hard to bear? Write about it honestly. If you are not sure, say so.
